text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday according to the official news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual's national speech, in which he called on Algerians to vote in June 5 parliamentary elections, completes colossal work of patience towards bringing country out of crisis.
- President Zeroual pays homage to the contribution by Algerian women during war of liberation and resistance to "terrorism".
- World women's day commemorated in Algiers, with cartoons showing minority situation of women, and photographs and articles on their protests against violence and "terrorism".
- President Zeroual calls on those involved in elections to show rigour and serenity to ensure poll goes ahead normally.
- Political party leaders look at possibility of alliances for the elections.
